label: Premium Local
visual_principles: Balance polished authority with local approachability.
Use restrained contrast, strong hierarchy, and clear proof.
Favor fewer, better sections over dense grid repetition.

typography.display: editorial serif or refined display sans

imagery.priority: practice, team, office, client-ready spaces, polished details

cta_rules: Use consultation, appointment, or contact language.
Pair primary CTA with reassurance or proof.
Avoid urgency unless the business type supports it.
